international.title: ‘Visceral response’: flag campaigns inspire anti-racism organising across England
international.summary: Exclusive: Study shows people taking action against far-right intimidation such as 75-year-old taking to his bike at 2am to remove flags Flag campaigns and far-right intimidation have sparked a wave of grassroots anti-racism organising across England in the past 12 months, according to new research. The Institute of Race Relations (IRR) warns that the widespread displays of St George’s cross and union jack flags have been accompanied by racist abuse and violence, with flags deliberately placed outside schools, mosques and care homes.
